options.label: Any%
options.rule: Beat the game as fast as possible.

subcategories.label: Zipless
subcategories.rule: The use of zips is prohibited.

options.label: True Ending
options.rule: Beat the game while getting the "true ending".

subcategories.label: No Major Glitches
subcategories.rule:
The use of major glitches is prohibited.
The following are considered major glitches:
- Zips
- Rewind Tricks
- Menu Launch
- Load trigger / Story / Cutscene Manipulation
- Sonic Glitch
- Rewind Wallrun Extension
- Quicksand
- Drop Glitch
- Trap Fall-Damage Cancel
- Silhouette Clipping
- Ledge Storage
- Canceling a wallrun by pausing

Check [this guide](https://speedrun.com/pop_ww/guide/eeumn) for detailed explanation of each glitch.
